page.overview:
Who is Spear Hybrid?

The Spear Hybrid (real name unknown) is a Devil-human Hybrid who merged with the の|Yari no Akuma}} and serves as a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc, where he faces the Chainsaw Devil.

He later returns in the Academy Saga as a supporting antagonist, working under the orders of Barem and the Chainsaw Man Church alongside his other fellow Weapon Humans.

The Spear Hybrid is a tall man with short blonde hair and a bit of stubble on his chin. He notably dons a pair of rectangle-shaped glasses and is usually seen with a cold expression on his face.

In most of his appearances, the Spear Hybrid wears a long, double-breasted coat layered over a sweater and collared dress shirt with dark-colored pants and shoes. During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, the Spear Hybrid wore the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie.
